body:
I changed the interface to non-template, instead evaluating `address` and `alignment` outside the function. I think this is better because it makes fewer assumptions.

> Maybe move it outside the global scope inside the class to call it like `Memory::get_offset` ?

I had it in the `Memory` as a static function first, it seems like static class functions cannot be truly `constexpr`. At least it refused to compile as such from my end, with a less than helpful error message:

```c++
./core/os/memory.h:63:26: error: constexpr variable 'ELEMENT_OFFSET' must be initialized by a constant expression
   63 |         static constexpr size_t ELEMENT_OFFSET = mem_aligned_address(SIZE_OFFSET + sizeof(uint64_t), alignof(uint64_t));
      |                                 ^                ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
./core/os/memory.h:63:43: note: undefined function 'mem_aligned_address' cannot be used in a constant expression
   63 |         static constexpr size_t ELEMENT_OFFSET = mem_aligned_address(SIZE_OFFSET + sizeof(uint64_t), alignof(uint64_t));
      |                                                  ^
./core/os/memory.h:57:26: note: declared here
   57 |         static constexpr size_t mem_aligned_address(size_t address, size_t alignment) {
      |                                 ^
./core/os/memory.h:64:26: error: constexpr variable 'DATA_OFFSET' must be initialized by a constant expression
   64 |         static constexpr size_t DATA_OFFSET = mem_aligned_address(ELEMENT_OFFSET + sizeof(uint64_t), alignof(max_align_t));
      |                                 ^             ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
./core/os/memory.h:64:60: note: initializer of 'ELEMENT_OFFSET' is not a constant expression
   64 |         static constexpr size_t DATA_OFFSET = mem_aligned_address(ELEMENT_OFFSET + sizeof(uint64_t), alignof(max_align_t));
      |                                                                   ^
./core/os/memory.h:63:26: note: declared here
   63 |         static constexpr size_t ELEMENT_OFFSET = mem_aligned_address(SIZE_OFFSET + sizeof(uint64_t), alignof(uint64_t));
      |                                 ^
```
It's a bit awkward, but I agree it beats needing a free function for this. I've adjusted the code accordingly, thanks!
